data = pd.read_csv('chunks_csv/bivariate/bivariate_2023_no2_energy.csv')

# Replace missing values in NO2_value with the mean of NO2_value
data['NO2_value'] = data['NO2_value'].fillna(data['NO2_value'].mean())

# Compute spatial weights matrix
adjacency_matrix = pd.merge(data, adjacency_data, on='borough')
adjacency_matrix = adjacency_matrix.groupby('borough')['neighbor'].apply(list).to_dict()

# Compute Lee's L statistic
def lee_l_statistic(data, adjacency_matrix):
    n = len(data)
    w = np.zeros((n, n))
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            if i != j and adjacency_matrix[data.iloc[i]['borough']] == data.iloc[j]['neighbor']:
                w[i, j] = 1

lee_l_statistic_value = lee_l_statistic(data, adjacency_matrix)

# Permutation test
p_value = 0

    energy_values = data['Energy_value'].copy()

    data['Energy_value'] = energy_values
    lee_l_statistic_value_perm = lee_l_statistic(data, adjacency_matrix)
